skill.displayName: TV Program Preview - 电视节目预告

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tv
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides a straightforward interface to the Jisu TV program API. The `tv.py` script correctly uses the `JISU_API_KEY` environment variable, makes HTTP GET requests to the documented `api.jisuapi.com` endpoint using the `requests` library, and handles JSON input and output safely. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts in the `SKILL.md` that would lead the agent to perform unauthorized actions. All code and instructions align with the stated purpose of querying TV program schedules.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required credential (JISU_API_KEY) align with its stated purpose of calling the Jisu TV API; nothing requests unrelated secrets or system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the implementation. The skill requires python3 and a JISU_API_KEY which are appropriate for calling the Jisu TV API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and tv.py restrict behavior to calling https://api.jisuapi.com/tv (channel and query). The script reads only JISU_API_KEY from the environment and issues HTTP GETs. Note: the Python code imports requests but SKILL.md does not list Python package dependencies; the runtime must provide the requests library or the script will fail.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only skill with an included script). Nothing is downloaded from arbitrary URLs and no archives are extracted.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JISU_API_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential. The script uses this key to call the external Jisu API (appkey sent as a query parameter), which is expected for this integration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not marked always:true and does not modify other skills or system settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but the skill's scope is limited to API calls.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent: it only needs a JISU_API_KEY and calls the Jisu TV endpoints. Before installing, ensure you trust the Jisu service with your API key and are comfortable with the key being sent in requests to api.jisuapi.com. Make sure the runtime environment has Python and the 'requests' package available (the SKILL.md does not declare Python package dependencies). If you want tighter control, consider providing a scoped API key with limited permissions/quota.
